title: Terrain-relative navigation with a particle filter
summary: A stdlib-only simulation of TERCOM/TRN: an aircraft with a biased INS and a radar altimeter matches its measured terrain profile against a seeded synthetic DEM with a particle filter that also estimates the INS velocity bias. Prints INS-only vs PF error over time, includes a flat-terrain control, and a rasterio loader for Copernicus GLO-30 tiles.
verified: terrain.py and trn_pf.py ran with python3.14.7 stdlib on 2026-11-06, output shown in README; dem_rasterio.py is an unverified sketch: syntax-checked only, requires rasterio (the GLO-30 tile URL returned HTTP 200 on 2026-11-06).
